question: In which of the following states/union territories has the Border Roads Organisation (BRO) constructed a 440-m-long tunnel to boost the Char Dham Project?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Border Roads Organisation **(BRO) has **constructed **a **440-metre **long tunnel in **Uttarakhand **to **boost **the **Char Dham Project**.

 
 
• The BRO **constructed **the tunnel below the densely populated **Chamba town **on **Rishikesh-Dharasu road** (**NH-94**).
 
• The **Chamba tunnel **is a **horse-shoe** type tunnel with a **10 m carriageway width **and **5.5 m vertical clearance**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Char Dham Project**

 
 
• The **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways** has taken up a **separate programme **for **connectivity Improvement **for **Char-Dham **(Kedarnath, Badrinath, Yamunotri & Gangothri) in **Uttarakhand**.
 
• There are a total of **53 civil works covering a distance of 889 kilometres**.
 
• It is a **proposed two-lane express National Highway **with a minimum **width **of **10 metres** in the state of **Uttarakhand**.
 
 
 
• The **BRO develops **and **maintains **road **networks **in **India’s border areas **and **friendly neighbouring countries **and **functions **under the **Ministry **of **Defence**.
 
 
• It is **entrusted **with the **construction **of **Roads**, **Bridges**, **Tunnels**, **Causeways**, **Helipads **and **Airfields** **along **the **borders**.
 
• 
 
**Under **the ''**Char Dham**'' project costing about Rs 12,000 crore, **BRO **is **constructing 250 km of National Highwa**y leading to holy shrines of **Gangotri **and **Badrinath**.
